[KmpPattern.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpPattern.java:8) now owns pattern validation, LPS preprocessing, reusable matching, and a small `occursIn` convenience API. I also updated [KmpSearchDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearchDemo.java:3) to use the new API and accept optional CLI args, and added [KmpSearchSelfTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/KmpSearchSelfTest.java:3) as an executable test harness covering basic matches, overlaps, no-match cases, length mismatches, and invalid inputs.
